answer.summary: No prior evidence supports non-feature-based memory stability or continuity in repeated query interactions under controlled conditions.
answer.content: Across multiple handoff reviews of Kumar et al., 2024, no explicit or implicit indicators of memory retention, contextual continuity, or response coherence emerge in the absence of feature vectors or external validation. All sections examined lack observable, non-feature-based metrics directly tied to query iteration or temporal consistency. The current research path remains unproductive without a new, focused inquiry into a distinct memory mechanism.
